headline: UK Approves Long-Delayed Jackdaw North Sea Gas Field
summary: Britain approved the Jackdaw North Sea gas field, ending years of legal and political wrangling as the government seeks to balance its energy security and climate goals.
why: North Sea oil and gas field approvals affect domestic UK energy supply, capital expenditures for participating energy firms, and broader national energy security policies.

impacts.name: Energy
impacts.why: Regulatory approval unlocks capital investment and future fossil fuel production potential in the North Sea basin.
